name: Eufy Control
author: Aperture
description: Pan/tilt and device control for Eufy cameras, through a eufy-security-ws server on your network. Adds a jog wheel over the picture and a device menu to the player toolbar.

settings.label: eufy-security-ws address
settings.help: Address of the eufy-security-ws bridge. On this deployment it is hosted locally as the eufy-security-ws service, so leave this as http://127.0.0.1:3000. Use http:// (not ws://) — the extension opens the WebSocket itself. Your Eufy credentials live in that service, never in this extension.

settings.label: Camera mapping
settings.help: Which Eufy device each Aperture camera is. The serial number is shown in the Eufy app under device settings.

settings.label: Jog step (ms)
settings.help: How long one nudge of the jog wheel moves the camera. Eufy pans in timed bursts rather than to an angle, so this is the unit of movement.
